dedupe_keys.name: traffic sign catalogue arrows and symbols class ix

description: Four named classes from the Alberta Traffic Sign Catalogue provide standard specifications and identification codes. Class IX covers arrows and symbols; WC covers intermittent moving hazards; ID covers miscellaneous information; IB covers route identification. PDF descriptors identify individual signs and ZIP descriptors identify scaled drawings. The classes include warnings, road identifiers and temporary or regulatory messages, but do not provide an installed-sign inventory or road locations. Some ID descriptors are archived versions. The source directs readers to the Highway Guide and Information Sign Manual for application and messaging guidance. These related catalogue components are grouped without claiming all sign classes or all historical versions are covered. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Government of Alberta; Transportation and Economic Corridors. Licence: Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says unrestricted; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
